name: NEW_STUDIO_EMAIL
body:
Dear {studio_name},

Congratulations! Your studio has been successfully registered.
We are thrilled to have you join us and look forward to helping your studio grow and connect with more dance enthusiasts.

If you have any questions or need assistance, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team.

We have created a user with a dummy password below, please update as per your convenience.

Username: {username}
Password: {password}

Best regards,
Book & Manage Team
subject: Welcome to Book & Manage !!
